name: CloudAppEvents
description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps and Office 365 cloud activity events

columns.name: ActionType
columns.description: Specific cloud action, e.g. FileDownloaded, New-InboxRule, Set-Mailbox

columns.name: Application
columns.description: Target cloud application, e.g. Microsoft Exchange Online, SharePoint Online

columns.name: IPAddress
columns.description: Client IP address initiating the cloud action

columns.name: CountryCode
columns.description: Two-letter ISO country code of client IP

columns.name: ActivityObjects
columns.description: JSON array of affected objects such as files, folders, or rules

columns.name: RawEventData
columns.description: Raw payload of the cloud audit event
